info.title: Delhi Stays Guest Assistant API
info.description: Location-aware, multi-property RAG assistant for Airbnb guests in Delhi. Guest endpoints under /api, admin endpoints under /api/admin (Bearer JWT).

schema.title: Response Get Locations Api Locations Get
Response Get Properties Api Properties Get
Response Get Messages Api Chat Sessions  Session Id  Messages Get

delete.summary: Clear conversation history (keeps the selected property)

post.summary: Send a guest message; response is a Server-Sent Events stream

schema.title: Response Admin Locations Api Admin Locations Get
Response Admin List Properties Api Admin Properties Get

delete.summary: Deactivate a property (or permanently delete with ?hard=true)

schema.title: Response List Documents Api Admin Documents Get

post.summary: Re-index every document (e.g. after changing embedding provider)

schema.title: Response List Curated Api Admin Curated Get

PlaceResult.title: PlaceResult
PlaceResult.description:
A local recommendation. Every field comes from Google Places or the host's
curated list - never generated by the LLM.

PropertySummary.title: PropertySummary
PropertySummary.description: Public, non-sensitive view of a property shown to guests.
